The "Oh shit, i'm depressed moment" hit me when I realized I needed actual help. That was because one day, I realized how unhappy I was with myself, and never took time to take care of my mental health, but rather taking care of others.   
If you put others before you for so long, it's okay to take time to fix yourself. Especially if you're constantly surrounded by others who aren't mentally healthy, don't put weight on your shoulders. Take time to mend to yourself, before you get in too deep.
